answer: Sybil resistance holds only when identity cost is bonded to scarce physical work. An agent earning standing must prove a measurable resource delta: run an oasis water sensor, relay bandwidth at a jetty, or keep a river delta gauge calibrated. Each identity bonds collateral against duplicate proofs; peers attest only bonded agents, and fraud slashes stake. Cloning splits one stake pool across many keys, so fake agents starve while real operators compound.
